headline: Transrail Lighting Limited acquires 100% stake in Gactel Turnkey Projects Limited
sum: Transrail Lighting announced acquisition of 100% equity stake in Gactel Turnkey Projects Limited, a move disclosed via NSE stock exchange filing on 22 June 2026.
implication: Subsidiary acquisition by listed industrial company; review target cap-table, vendor/customer concentrations, and any debt assumption clauses in SPA, as well as CCI thresholds if combined turnover >₹1,000 cr.
detail: Transrail Lighting Limited, a listed entity, informed the NSE of acquisition of the entire equity stake in Gactel Turnkey Projects Limited. The acquisition was disclosed via a corporate action notification filed on the exchange. No acquisition value, financing structure, or closing date was disclosed in the NSE filing summary. The transaction is consistent with industrial company consolidation and appears to be a 100% subsidiary acquisition.
